recrow

components · 0.6.1 · C3 · aj-c-recrow

The recording: the only row that carries a tone (--block-2 ground, --block marks). Its head always carries the 58px column, holding the time on a day's screen and the date on Timeline, present and empty where the row continues the day above (empty is not absent); beside it play, the waveform and the duration. The transcript body below is present on Pro and absent on Free, and holds the entry actions in the same gutter as the written row. The one head without the column is the capture surface, which stacks, because a recording in progress has no timestamp yet.

token--aj-c-recrow-progressexposed: The live memo's playback progress, 0 to 1 (0); the runtime sets it on the row each frame while it plays, and keeps the position reached on a stop. The progress clip scales by it.
token--aj-c-recrow-timer-chexposed: The live memo clock's width in characters (8); the runtime sets it on the row from the length of the total.
token--aj-c-recrow-dateexposed: The time column's colour in the dated head. The Timeline's record sets it to the day's mood colour while the day is framed after a jump (v4 C1).
token--aj-c-recrow-date-fadeexposed: The dated head's time column transition (none). The record sets it while the date takes the mood colour.
statedefaultyes: as rendered
statehovern/a: no hover of its own; play has its own, and the entry actions reveal themselves
statefocus-visiblen/a: not focusable from the keyboard (the runtime focuses a new memo row programmatically, tabindex=-1); its controls carry the ring
stateactiven/a: the row is not a control; play presses
statedisabledn/a: the row is not a control
stateselectedn/a: rows are not selectable
stateloadingn/a: transcribing is the body's copy, not a state of the row
stateerrorn/a: a playback failure is a notice the runtime adds beside the row
stateemptyn/a: a memo always has its head; a missing transcript is the Free form (no body), not an empty row
